NRC IRAP financing and the independent CENGN testbed relationship are supported; broader customer and partner logos are not treated as proof.
The official site publishes contact page, email, phone and current office; the older LinkedIn address is retained only as a discovery warning.

The current official address supersedes the supplied LinkedIn location for candidate use; self-reported defence and certification claims remain excluded pending independent verification.
